why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Open bullshot.io , the site linked from Bullshot's X account, @Bullshot911.
Connect a wallet and pick BNB Chain in the network selector.
Share your referral link, which appears once a wallet is connected.
If you want, play Bull Gems at gem.bullshot.io with a wallet on Base, and do its daily tasks.

When a coin moves to PancakeSwap, the contract takes a launch fee from its BNB pool. The docs describe it as a "Fee taken from ETH pool at DEX launch", and on-chain it was set to 10%.
